description: This file implements static methods for the IWorkerPool interface within the Thunder::Core namespace, managing a singleton instance of a worker pool.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::Assign
methods.description: Assigns a singleton instance of IWorkerPool, with an assertion to ensure proper state.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IWorkerPool instance, asserting it is initialized.

methods.name: IWorkerPool::IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the singleton IWorkerPool instance is available (initialized).
